purpose: One vocabulary for classifying competitor ads (POST /v1/media/classify-creative, Creative Patterns section) and for describing our own variants (ads campaign pack). Pattern keys use the closed values below so that the same pattern converges across competitors; verbatim excerpts carry the detail.

hook_type.description: How the ad earns the first second of attention.

values.pain_problem: Opens on the problem or pain the viewer has.
values.desired_outcome: Opens on the result the viewer wants.
values.before_after_bridge: Contrasts life before and after, the product is the bridge.
values.identity_callout: Names who the ad is for (For marketers, Developers who...).
values.curiosity_gap: Withholds the answer so the viewer wants to read on.
values.social_proof: Leads with numbers of users, reviews, logos or testimonials.
values.value_framing: Leads with one concrete number and outcome (10 minutes a day, 40% off).
values.contrarian: Challenges a common belief or the usual way of doing it.
values.challenge: Dares the viewer to test themselves or prove something.
values.direct_offer: Leads with the offer itself (free trial, discount, demo).
values.announcement: Leads with news: launch, new feature, new course, event.
values.other: A clear hook that fits none of the above.
values.unknown: The evidence does not show the hook.

message_shape.description: The rhetorical shape of the main text.

values.question: Asks the viewer a question.
values.statistic: States a number or data point.
values.first_person_story: Tells a personal story or testimonial in the first person.
values.comparison: Compares with alternatives or the old way.

pain_kind.description: The problem the ad says it removes.

values.delay: Things take too long; slow progress.
values.complexity: Too complicated, confusing, hard to start.
values.risk: Fear of failure, mistakes, security or compliance risk.
values.missed_opportunity: Falling behind, missing growth, career or market chances.
values.skill_gap: Lacking a skill, knowledge or qualification.
values.poor_results: Current tools or methods give bad results.
values.price: Alternatives are too expensive; price sensitivity.
values.trust: Distrust of vendors, billing, hidden fees.
values.other: A pain that fits none of the above.
values.unknown: The evidence does not show it.

values.outcome: A concrete result (get hired, build an app, more leads).
values.status_identity: Recognition, belonging, becoming a certain kind of person.

claim_strength.description: Claims that need proof when copied.

values.quantified: Contains a number or measurable result.
values.superiority: Claims to be the best, first or only.
values.guarantee: Promises a guaranteed result or refund.

proof_kinds.description: Evidence the ad shows for its claims.

values.fact: A checkable fact about the service.
values.statistic: A data point or study result.
values.testimonial: A quote or story from a customer.

offer_kind.description: The deal the ad asks the viewer to accept. Not the button: 'Sign up' alone is a CTA, not an offer.

values.free_trial: Time-limited free use of the paid product.
values.freemium: A free plan or free tier.
values.free_tool: A free standalone tool or calculator.
values.free_sample: A free lesson, chapter or sample.
values.lead_magnet: A guide, template, checklist or report for contact details.
values.call_booking: Book a demo, call or consultation.
values.discount: A price cut, promo code or sale.
values.direct_purchase: Buy now at the stated price.
values.paid_pilot: A paid pilot or trial project.
values.waitlist: Join a waitlist or early access.
values.content: Read or watch content with no ask.
values.unknown: The evidence does not show it.

values.deadline: Ends on a date or soon.

values.professional: Working professionals upskilling for their job.
values.creator: Creators and freelancers.
values.team: Teams or managers buying for a team.

values.explicit: The segment is named in the ad.
values.implied: The segment is implied by the situation.

format_kind.description: The creative format; the runner sets it from platform metadata when the platform reports it.

values.dynamic: A dynamic or catalog ad assembled by the platform.
values.promoted_post: A native post promoted as an ad.
values.chat_card: A card inside an AI chat answer.

values.text_on_surface: Text written on a surface (note, sticky, notebook).
values.question_card: A question as the main visual.
values.stat_card: A number or statistic as the main visual.
values.native_post: Looks like a native post or screenshot of one.
values.product_screenshot: A screenshot or UI of the product.
values.talking_head: A person talking to the camera.

cta_intent.description: What the button or call to action asks; the runner sets it from the platform CTA code when one exists.

values.sign_up: Sign up or create an account.
values.book: Book a demo, call or seat.
values.get_offer: Get the offer or claim the deal.

landing_page_type.description: Where the click lands, judged from the landing URL and the ad.

values.product_page: A product, course or catalog page.
values.lead_form: A lead form on the site.
values.native_lead_form: A lead form inside the ad platform.

search_intent.description: For Google search text ads only: the intent of the keyword the ad was shown for.

values.vendor_seeking: Looking for a provider or course.
values.tool_seeking: Looking for a tool or app.
values.competitor_alternative: Looking for an alternative to a named brand.

hook_text.description: The words that carry the hook, verbatim.

pain_text.description: The words that name the pain, verbatim.

promise_text.description: The words that make the promise, verbatim.

proof_text.description: The proof as shown, verbatim (numbers are never copied).

offer_text.description: The words that state the offer, verbatim.

offer_details.price_amount: Number shown as the price, or null.
offer_details.price_currency: ISO currency code of that price, or null.
offer_details.trial_days: Length of the free trial in days, or null.
